subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should #100121 remain the separate tracker for zero-payload tool-error reply policy while #96857 and related PRs own the broader `(see attached image)` provider/projection cluster?
rationale: Automation can identify the remaining source branches, but it should not choose whether replay-unsafe tool-error turns emit a concise exec warning, an incomplete-turn fallback, or stay delegated to the broader placeholder issue.

options.title: Keep separate fallback tracker
options.body: Keep #100121 open for the no-reply/tool-error fallback decision and let #96857/#99241 plus active PRs handle provider placeholder repairs.

options.title: Fold into #96857
options.body: Close this as partial duplicate only after maintainers explicitly decide that the fallback-policy branch belongs in the broad placeholder canonical issue.

options.title: Split narrower issue
options.body: Create a narrower issue for `lastToolError` plus zero-payload fallback behavior, then close #100121 as superseded by that tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep separate fallback tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #100121 open for the no-reply/tool-error fallback decision and let #96857/#99241 plus active PRs handle provider placeholder repairs.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining unique decision sits closest to the incomplete-turn recovery path they previously changed in #93073.
